notes.title: MANIKA V1.3 IS NOW OUT!
notes.notes:
This update brings you these changes:

-Major bug fixes.
-Little level design changes.
-English and Turkish is now fully supported.

Known issues:

-After "You Are Dead" screen, sound and animation glitches out until loading last save.

Let us know about your advices in the reviews! Thanks for playing!
